classification: Posthoc exploratory diagnosis of already-inspected outcomes; not a new blind test, no causal attribution
question: Why controls had higher fraction positive compounded Jan-Sep2026 net return than validation survivors; diagnose settings, basket composition, market regimes without new winner

cohorts.Q1: approximately top20percent defined development Sharpe within basket, not calendar Q1

primary: 20bps one-way full-L1 target changes; inherited lag1 idealized observed-close execution, not an actual 1h fill delay
inputs: Previously finalized metrics, daily paths, membership, catalogs, and seven audited 22-slot source panels only. Verify parent pins before decode. No new archives/downloads/trades/simulator runs.

settings.decomposition: Controls-minus-survivors fraction-positive gap. Exact symmetric Kitagawa over common strata; original cohort shares. Unsupported strata explicit direct contributions, not imputed survivor rates. Family and full experiment; plus renormalized common support. Exact config standardization uses pooled all-Q1 case weights fixed from historical membership.

basket.summaries: 22 coins in historical liquidity order; fixed BTC/ETH not estimated. Inclusion frequencies by historical cohorts; per-basket gap/decomposition; configuration-standardized inclusion vs exclusion associations for20 variable coins separately per cohort.
basket.no_causal_coin_effects: Within-tier substitution and overlapping baskets, historical/Q1 selection and lifecycle confounding. No isolated coin experiment. Report support denominators, no coin/basket winners.
basket.inference: All coin, basket and settings cuts descriptive; no IID pair SE, no uncorrected significance stars. A joint config+basket additive fixed-effect linear projection may be provided as descriptive sensitivity if stable and audited; not causality.

regimes.decision_time: Features computed at day d00UTC from information ending at d, labels apply to following interval[d,d+1). Original carried net daily paths, no regime switching or resets.

features.btc_volatility: sample SD of30 contiguous BTC daily logreturns ending at d, sqrt365; high vs low using median2022-23 only
features.dispersion: sample SD of contemporaneous previous24h simple returns among22 fixed economic slots with finite positive prices and observed endpoints; require>=8 valid slots; high vs low median2022-23 only
features.relative_btc_quote_volume: BTC previous24 hourly quote-volume sum /mean of30 preceding complete daily volume sums excluding current24h; high vs low median2022-23 only

regimes.unknown: Retain unknown explicitly; never fill. State day counts, data coverage and fixed slots. No discontinuous-regime Sharpe.
regimes.statistics: Cohort cross-path daily arithmetic mean return (bps), daily-positive breadth, median path daily return, and mean log-return contributions by regime. These averages are not a proposed invested portfolio. Monthly carried-path results. Gross/control full-period metrics exist; no unsupported control fee/delay scenarios or daily-turnover inference.
regimes.four_posthoc_tests: For each of4 predefined regime features, interaction = (controls-minus-survivors mean daily net return in high/up) minus corresponding gap in low/down. Reuse4000 synchronized28-day circular calendar bootstrap indices from parent; resample regime labels and paired daily cohort summary together. Marginal95percent percentile CIs, centered2sided plus1 p, Holm4 over these4only; not full-research-search correction. Unknown excluded only from known-state contrast and counts retained.
regimes.context: Period-level BTC/ETH returns, volatility, fixed22 dispersion, relative volume and valid counts for development2022-23,validation2024-25,partial2026; daily14/28day trailing-return vs nextday cross-sectional Spearman across fixed22 as contextual diagnostic only, not basket engine signal or new strategy.
regimes.asset_context: 22-slot Jan-Sep endpoint buyhold marks if available and hourly observed/tradable/hold_allowed fractions; no replacement of retired slots. BTCETH fixed membership unidentifiable.

uncertainty: Retain prior aggregate screening-gap interval. New settings/coin cuts descriptive only. Four new regime tests explicitly posthoc and corrected only within own small family. Shared calendar dependence, limited9months, selection and nonstationarity remain.
deliverables: Separate local non-cloud report and offline HTML
module_policy: Each module script hash recorded before executing real outcome analysis; scientific repairs explicitly logged. Protocol is a posthoc analysis-plan receipt, not pristine pre-OOS freeze.
